requestedScopeConstraint.description: A constraint on a requested scope.

attribute.description: Attribute the constraint applies to: `meteringPoint.id`, `type` (server-generated allowed contract types), or `validFrom`.

value.description: Allowed string values for the attribute. Move-in validFrom input accepts an ISO date or timestamp; responses use a timestamp with the Europe/Oslo offset.

authorizationScopeConstraint.description: A constraint on a granted scope.

attribute.description: Attribute the constraint applies to: `meteringPoint.id`, `type`, or `validFrom`.

value.description: Allowed string values: metering-point IDs, contract types (EndUser or EnergySupplier), or validFrom timestamps with the Europe/Oslo offset.
